title: Find the person who sees you
subtitle: Tell Bliss what you want the day to feel like in photos. We'll turn that into a small, sourced shortlist—not an endless directory.

dashboard.title: Find your photographer
dashboard.body: Shape your style and coverage, compare a focused shortlist, then prepare outreach and calendar holds.

intro.title: What should the photos feel like?
intro.body: A mood is enough. Bliss will ask only what changes the search.
intro.promptDocumentary: We want honest, candid photos that let us stay present instead of posing all day.
intro.promptEditorial: We love an editorial look, but we still want the day to feel relaxed and like us.
intro.promptClassic: We want timeless photos our families will love, with dependable coverage and a clear budget.
